Portal contract: Settings and ScreenCast

Settings status: accepted, version 0.1.0 (ScreenCast is a draft, below). The cbc2 verification of services/portald passed on the commit that carries it (dcd2f1a). The commands and wire shapes below are fixed by the XDG portal specification.

portald implements the Settings interface of the XDG desktop portal, on the session bus, for the org.freedesktop.appearance namespace. The machine-checkable key table is in portal.spec.mix.

Bus identity

ItemValue
Bus nameorg.freedesktop.portal.Desktop (requested without queueing)
Object path/org/freedesktop/portal/desktop
Interfaceorg.freedesktop.portal.Settings, version property 2
Error prefixorg.freedesktop.portal.Error

Methods and signal

  • Read(s namespace, s key) -> v: the value in one extra variant layer, deprecated form.
  • ReadOne(s namespace, s key) -> v: the value in a single layer.
  • ReadAll(as namespaces) -> a{sa{sv}}: globs matched against namespaces. An unmatched glob yields no namespace entry. An empty array or any empty filter matches all namespaces. Up to 64 filters of 256 bytes each are accepted; larger requests return org.freedesktop.portal.Error.InvalidArgument.
  • SettingChanged(s namespace, s key, v value): emitted only when a key's value changes.

An unserved namespace or key on Read or ReadOne returns org.freedesktop.portal.Error.NotFound.

Keys

NamespaceKeyWire typeValues
org.freedesktop.appearancecolor-schemeu1 dark, 2 light
org.freedesktop.appearancecontrastu0 normal, 1 high
org.freedesktop.appearanceaccent-color(ddd)sRGB 0 to 1; absent when the source has no accent

Defaults before any projection: color-scheme 1 (dark), contrast 0, no accent-color.

Source and identity

  • Source command: settings.appearance.get, read-only, from settingsd.
  • The reply carries the atomic snapshot evidence alongside the projection. The shared settings Consumer checks the evidence and manages subscription, initial reads, lifecycle generations, delivery loss and bounded recovery.
  • Trigger: authenticated retained topic settingsd.desktop.changed.<profile>. A publication also triggers a read when settingsd restarts at the same revision.
  • A projection is identified by binding, incarnation and revision. A projection older than the held one within the same incarnation is refused and counted as stale. An equal identity changes nothing. A new incarnation is adopted.
  • The authority's projection schema is APPEARANCE_SCHEMA = 1. An unknown schema is refused.

Startup

  1. Load the validated binding-specific cache at <state directory>/<instance>/<profile>/appearance.json, else defaults. A mismatched binding and the old unpartitioned cache are ignored.
  2. Request the bus name without queueing immediately. A held name refuses a second instance. Authority work runs asynchronously.
  3. Answer Read within 250 ms of process launch, tested with the production binary and configuration against a silent authority, including cache and profile switch.
  4. Serve, and back off on source failure from 250 ms to 30 s. Transport recovery remains alive through initial broker failure.

The name is never held waiting on the source.

Commands

portald.status (read-only) is registered in docs/docs/spec/bus/commands.conf.mix.

Compatibility

Version 2 of the interface is the one served. A breaking change to a method shape, key type or key value needs a new interface version, and both versions must be served during the deprecation period.

ScreenCast

Status: draft. Served with portald serve --screencast; first verified on desk12 VT4, 2026-10-20 (a 3840x2160 frame received through the portal by a PipeWire consumer). The method and signal shapes are fixed by the XDG portal specification; what MixOS offers within them is below.

ItemValue
Interfaceorg.freedesktop.portal.ScreenCast, version property 5, same object
AvailableSourceTypes1 (monitor)
AvailableCursorModes3 (hidden, embedded)
Request path/org/freedesktop/portal/desktop/request/<sender>/<handle_token>
Session path/org/freedesktop/portal/desktop/session/<sender>/<session_handle_token>

<sender> is the caller's unique name without the leading : and with . as _. A token is 1 to 64 ASCII letters, digits or _; an absent token is generated.

  • CreateSession(a{sv}) -> o: Response 0 with session_handle (s).
  • SelectSources(o, a{sv}) -> o: types must include 1; cursor_mode 1 or 2 (default 1); otherwise InvalidArgument at the call. multiple and persist_mode are accepted and ignored. Response 0.
  • Start(o, s, a{sv}) -> o: InvalidArgument before SelectSources or when already started. Response 0 with streams a(ua{sv}) (one stream: position (ii), size (ii) in logical coordinates, source_type 1, id the output name) and persist_mode 0; Response 2 when nothing can be captured.
  • OpenPipeWireRemote(o, a{sv}) -> h: after a successful Start only.
  • Every Response is addressed to the owner. Request.Close by the owner removes the request with no Response; a Start closed this way stops its cast.
  • A session is the caller's alone: another caller gets NotFound (methods) or AccessDenied (Session.Close). It ends on Session.Close (no signal), on its owner leaving the bus, or with Session.Closed when capture stops on its own.
  • The stream is a PipeWire node with media.class Video/Source, BGRx, the output's mode size, variable rate up to 30 fps, memfd buffers.

Consent: every Start is granted by the allow policy, a standing grant matching the caller's process name, or an answer to a notifyd question (Allow / Deny, 60 s, timeout denies). A refusal answers Response 1. Bus commands, all local-only (broker_origin must be local, else rc 13 FORBIDDEN): portald.screencast.pending (query), portald.screencast.answer {request, allow} (input), portald.screencast.grant {app?, count?, ttl_ms?} (intent), portald.screencast.revoke {id?} (intent). Registered in docs/docs/spec/bus/commands.conf.mix.

Deferred

  • The FileChooser interface.
  • ScreenCast: window sources, several streams, restore tokens, DMA-BUF frames and a permission-limited remote.
  • Accent as a settings field. The current projection carries the design's resolved accent through settingsd's in-memory sidecar, outside the sealed snapshot.
  • Caller identity and sandboxed app IDs.
